evidence: Demo-only interest inference; no live trend claim

candidates.reason: Good for developer productivity, requires more workflow design.

candidates.reason: Useful but sourcing changes safely requires extra integration work.

ideas.name: Local developer task board
ideas.problem: Small development tasks scatter across terminal notes and become hard to finish
ideas.mechanism: Local-first task board that pairs work items with a next-action command
ideas.first_demo: Add a task, list it, complete it and reopen its saved state
ideas.hook: A single next-action view that feels like a lightweight workbench
ideas.interest_basis: Illustrative developer-productivity interest supplied in example data, not inferred private history

ideas.name: Project handoff generator
ideas.problem: Reconstructing decisions after a paused project consumes time and loses caveats
ideas.mechanism: Inspect a chosen repository and create a bounded executable continuation brief
ideas.first_demo: Turn a toy repository into a clear status and first-run handoff
ideas.hook: A project time capsule that includes evidence rather than a generic summary
ideas.interest_basis: Example seed from an explicit handoff workflow; no connected-account claim

ideas.name: Dependency digest
ideas.problem: It is hard to see which dependency updates actually affect a chosen project
ideas.mechanism: Compare local dependency manifests with explicitly supplied release-note samples
ideas.first_demo: Feed a local manifest and a fixture, then produce an impact-oriented change digest
ideas.hook: Explains why each change matters before suggesting any upgrade
ideas.interest_basis: Adjacent to development tasks; trend status not asserted

ideas.name: Rehearsal studio
ideas.problem: Rehearsing a presentation feels abstract without varied reactions and reflection
ideas.mechanism: Local branching role-play cards with optional replay and self-reflection
ideas.first_demo: Pick a scenario, choose two responses and compare how the dialogue changes
ideas.hook: A low-stakes stage for trying three different ways to say one thing
ideas.interest_basis: Creative wildcard, not a known user preference

ideas.name: Repair storybook
ideas.problem: Small recurring home problems are forgotten between repairs
ideas.mechanism: Offline repair logs that connect symptoms, actions and later outcomes
ideas.first_demo: Record a fictional leaking tap, add the fix and find its history
ideas.hook: A memory of what actually worked, not another generic to-do list
ideas.interest_basis: Everyday-life wildcard; does not require personal or home access

ideas.name: Borrow circle
ideas.problem: Members repeatedly buy rarely used tools while nearby members could lend them
ideas.mechanism: Opt-in inventory and loan request ledger with no automatic outreach
ideas.first_demo: Create sample members and request a shared item in an offline demo
ideas.hook: A tiny lending library for things too awkward to borrow casually
ideas.interest_basis: Concept inspired by a general community pattern, not a verified current trend

ideas.name: Concept dojo
ideas.audience: Self-taught learners building confidence with new concepts
ideas.problem: Reading explanations alone does not reveal misunderstandings before practice
ideas.mechanism: Micro-challenges that ask for an explanation before revealing worked examples
ideas.first_demo: Attempt one seeded concept, get actionable feedback and retry
ideas.hook: Turns the moment of confusion into a short deliberate practice loop
ideas.interest_basis: Adjacent to personal-project learning, not based on hidden history

ideas.name: Reading lens
ideas.audience: People who prefer configurable reading layouts
ideas.problem: Long dense instructions can be tiring to scan at a fixed width and spacing
ideas.mechanism: Local text viewer with adjustable line length, spacing and landmark navigation
ideas.first_demo: Load fixture instructions and switch between two legible reading layouts
ideas.hook: Adapts a document to the reader without rewriting its meaning

ideas.name: Quiet hours planner
ideas.problem: Collaborators accidentally schedule distracting tasks over focus windows
ideas.mechanism: Shared sample calendar with explicit focus-hour conflict warnings
ideas.first_demo: Add fictional events and visualize an avoidable overlap
ideas.hook: Negotiates quiet time before the interruption happens
ideas.interest_basis: Unprompted practical wildcard; no access to real calendars assumed

ideas.name: Fixture forge
ideas.problem: Realistic, reproducible test data is slow to prepare safely
ideas.mechanism: Schema-driven local fixture generation with edge-case presets
ideas.first_demo: Generate seeded JSON records and run deterministic edge-case presets
ideas.hook: Makes awkward test cases easy without copying production data
ideas.interest_basis: Adjacent to testing and development, no production-data access
